body:
## Pull request overview

Refactors the Console app’s MSW mock setup to follow the upstream `@objectstack/studio` pattern by centralizing kernel bootstrapping and MSW handler creation, and makes the CLI `studio` command start the Console dev server for in-browser preview.

**Changes:**
- Added shared `createKernel()` factory for consistent ObjectKernel + InMemoryDriver bootstrap.
- Added shared `createHandlers()` factory used by both browser (worker) and Node (test server) MSW setups.
- Updated `objectui studio` CLI command to locate the Console app and run `pnpm run dev`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/cli/src/commands/studio.ts | Implements `objectui studio` by locating `apps/console` and spawning `pnpm run dev`. |
| apps/console/src/mocks/server.ts | Simplifies Node MSW server setup to reuse shared kernel + handlers factories. |
| apps/console/src/mocks/browser.ts | Simplifies browser MSW worker setup to reuse shared kernel + handlers factories. |
| apps/console/src/mocks/handlers.ts | New shared MSW handler factory covering discovery, metadata, and CRUD endpoints. |
| apps/console/src/mocks/createKernel.ts | New shared kernel bootstrap factory returning `{ kernel, driver }`. |
</details>
